en: Black‑and‑white image of an indoor post office or parcel counter. A woman behind the counter is processing a parcel for two men in heavy coats and hats standing on the customer side; another man waits behind them. Parcels and letters are visible on the counter, and a large window reveals parked cars and a street outside. The clothing and interior style suggest a mid‑20th‑century European setting.
